scripts.build: next build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('out')){console.error('ERROR: out directory not found!');process.exit(1);}else{console.log('✓ Build successful: out directory exists');const files=fs.readdirSync('out');console.log('✓ Found',files.length,'files in out directory');}"
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('out')){console.log('✓ Post-build: out directory verified');const files=fs.readdirSync('out');console.log('✓ Total files:',files.length);}else{console.error('ERROR: out directory missing after build');process.exit(1);}"
